name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    # Run on all pull requests (create and update)
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

# Cancel any in-progress run for the same branch/PR when a new commit is pushed, so superseded
# builds don't keep occupying runners. head_ref is set on pull_request events (the PR's source
# branch); for pushes it's empty, so we fall back to ref (e.g. refs/heads/main). Including the
# workflow name keeps groups from colliding with other workflows.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Backend tests run as parallel jobs, one per module group, instead of a single monolithic
  # `./gradlew build`. The old single job serialized the two largest suites (game-server + rules-engine)
  # to the end on one runner; splitting them onto separate runners makes wall-clock ≈ the slowest group
  # instead of the sum. Runner minutes are free on this public repo, so the extra runners cost nothing.
  # Each group warms from the persistent build cache (see settings.gradle.kts + the cache step below).
  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: engine            # the engine's own tests (card scenarios are the groups below)
            tasks: ":rules-engine:test"
          - name: scenarios-old     # card scenarios, sets released up to 2022
            tasks: >-
              :mtg-sets:1993-1999:tests:test :mtg-sets:2000-2002:tests:test
              :mtg-sets:2003-2007:tests:test :mtg-sets:2008-2016:tests:test
              :mtg-sets:2017-2022:tests:test
          - name: scenarios-2023-24 # card scenarios, the two biggest recent eras
            tasks: ":mtg-sets:2023:tests:test :mtg-sets:2024:tests:test"
          - name: scenarios-2025-26
            tasks: ":mtg-sets:2025:tests:test :mtg-sets:2026:tests:test"
          - name: server            # Spring Boot integration tests; compiles the full module graph
            tasks: ":game-server:test"
          - name: content           # SDK + card definitions + AI advisors
            tasks: ":mtg-sdk:test :mtg-sets:test :ai:test :mtg-search:test"
          - name: tools             # gym RL env + mtgish coverage tooling
            tasks: ":gym:test :gym-server:test :gym-trainer:test :mtgish-tooling:test"
    name: test (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # Relocate Gradle's local build cache into the workspace so the cache step below can persist it
      # across runs (settings.gradle.kts reads this var). setup-gradle's own build cache only restores
      # on an exact key match, so it never reuses the populated cache saved on main.
      GRADLE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.gradle/build-cache

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      # Persist the Gradle build cache (compiled classes + test results) across runs. Unlike
      # setup-gradle's exact-key build cache, actions/cache restore-keys do prefix matching and pick
      # the most-recent entry. The key is per-group so the four parallel jobs don't clobber each
      # other's save; the second restore-key lets a group bootstrap from any other group's cache
      # (e.g. a fresh `tools` run reuses `engine`'s compiled rules-engine).
      - name: Cache Gradle build outputs
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/.gradle/build-cache
          key: gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.name }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.name }}-
            gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Test
        # Wrapped in a watchdog: if a group hasn't finished within the timeout it is almost certainly
        # the intermittent ":game-server" hang where a forked test-worker JVM never terminates (a
        # lingering non-daemon thread). Before killing it we dump the stacks of every live JVM (Gradle
        # daemon + test workers) so the exact blocking thread is named in the log instead of inferred.
        # See SchedulingConfig / SessionRegistry for prior fixes.
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          JPS="${JAVA_HOME}/bin/jps"
          JSTACK="${JAVA_HOME}/bin/jstack"
          WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT=$((20 * 60))

          ./gradlew ${{ matrix.tasks }} &
          BUILD_PID=$!

          (
            sleep "${WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT}"
            echo "::error::Tests exceeded ${WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT}s — assuming the forked test-worker hang. Dumping JVM threads."
            for pid in $("${JPS}" -q); do
              echo "===================== jstack ${pid} ====================="
              "${JSTACK}" -l "${pid}" 2>&1 || true
            done
            echo "::error::Killing hung run."
            kill -9 "${BUILD_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
          ) &
          WATCHDOG_PID=$!

          wait "${BUILD_PID}"
          STATUS=$?
          kill "${WATCHDOG_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
          exit "${STATUS}"

      - name: Preserve actual JUnit results for receiving review
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-junit-${{ matrix.name }}
          path: '**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload Pest V2 deterministic diagnostic
        if: always() && matrix.name == 'content'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pest-control-v2-deterministic-diagnostic
          path: build/reports/pest-control-v2-diagnostic/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  # Aggregate gate so branch protection can keep requiring a single "backend" check. It passes only
  # if every test group passed; with fail-fast disabled, a failure in one group still surfaces all
  # others before this job reports.
  backend:
    needs: [test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify all test groups passed
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::One or more backend test groups failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All backend test groups passed."

  # Coverage runs only on main, off the PR critical path (Kover instruments the 3 covered modules'
  # test runs, and report generation + the PR comment add serial steps). Coverage is non-gating
  # (min 0); main-only keeps PR feedback fast while still tracking the trend on the default branch.
  coverage:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GRADLE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.gradle/build-cache
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Cache Gradle build outputs
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/.gradle/build-cache
          key: gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-coverage-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-coverage-
            gradle-build-cache-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate coverage report
        run: ./gradlew koverXmlReport

      - name: Extract coverage percentage
        id: coverage
        run: |
          MISSED=$(grep -oP 'type="INSTRUCTION" missed="\K[0-9]+' build/reports/kover/report.xml | head -1)
          COVERED=$(grep -oP 'type="INSTRUCTION" missed="[0-9]+" covered="\K[0-9]+' build/reports/kover/report.xml | head -1)
          TOTAL=$((MISSED + COVERED))
          PERCENT=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.1f\", ($COVERED / $TOTAL) * 100}")
          echo "coverage=$PERCENT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

#      - name: Update coverage badge

    steps:

      - name: Set up Node 22

      - name: Install dependencies

name: Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Downcase Image Name
        run: |
          echo "IMAGE_REPO=${REGISTRY}/${IMAGE_NAME,,}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build and push Backend
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./game-server/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.IMAGE_REPO }}/backend:latest
          build-args: |
            COMMIT_HASH=${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Build and push Frontend
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: ./web-client
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.IMAGE_REPO }}/frontend:latest
          build-args: |
            COMMIT_HASH=${{ github.sha }}


  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    environment:
      name: production

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Copy docker-compose to server
        uses: appleboy/scp-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SERVER_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SERVER_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          source: "docker-compose.yml"
          target: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_PATH }}

      - name: Deploy via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SERVER_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SERVER_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            REGISTRY="ghcr.io"
            IMAGE_REPO_LOWER=$(echo "${{ github.repository }}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            FULL_IMAGE_REPO="$REGISTRY/$IMAGE_REPO_LOWER"

            echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

            cd ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_PATH }}

            echo "IMAGE_REPO=$FULL_IMAGE_REPO" > .env
            echo "APP_DOMAIN=${{ secrets.APP_DOMAIN }}" >> .env
            echo "PROJECT_NAME=${{ secrets.PROJECT_NAME }}" >> .env
            echo "CACHE_REDIS_ENABLED=true" >> .env
            echo "CACHE_REDIS_TTL_MINUTES=1440" >> .env
            echo "GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}" >> .env
            echo "GAME_AI_ENABLED=true" >> .env
            echo "OPENROUTER_API_KEY=${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}" >> .env

            # --- Accounts / persistence (opt-in) ---
            # Always write the DB password so the Postgres volume initialises with the real password
            # from first boot. Changing it after the volume exists requires recreating the volume.
            echo "ACCOUNTS_DB_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.ACCOUNTS_DB_PASSWORD }}" >> .env
            if [ "${{ secrets.ACCOUNTS_ENABLED }}" = "true" ]; then
              echo "ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=true" >> .env
              # Clear the exclude so the DataSource + Flyway auto-config activates.
              echo "ACCOUNTS_AUTOCONFIG_EXCLUDE=" >> .env
              echo "ACCOUNTS_AUTH_SECRET=${{ secrets.ACCOUNTS_AUTH_SECRET }}" >> .env
              echo "ACCOUNTS_FROM_EMAIL=${{ secrets.ACCOUNTS_FROM_EMAIL }}" >> .env
              echo "MAIL_HOST=${{ secrets.MAIL_HOST }}" >> .env
              echo "MAIL_PORT=${{ secrets.MAIL_PORT }}" >> .env
              echo "MAIL_USERNAME=${{ secrets.MAIL_USERNAME }}" >> .env
              echo "MAIL_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.MAIL_PASSWORD }}" >> .env
            fi

            docker compose pull
            docker compose up -d --force-recreate --remove-orphans
            docker image prune -f

name: E2E Nightly

    - cron: '0 3 * * *'  # 3:00 AM UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:       # Allow manual triggers

jobs:
  e2e:

      - name: Install web client dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: web-client

      - name: Install E2E dependencies

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5

      - uses: extractions/setup-just@f8a3cce218d9f83db3a2ecd90e41ac3de6cdfd9b
      - name: Bind exact source, original sixteen cases and separate prospective four
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
          path=pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json')
          raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          assert manifest['budget_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-budget.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          extra=manifest['additional_budget']
          assert extra['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(extra['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert extra['expected_actual_cases']==4
          head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
          tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
          assert head==os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE']
          assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',manifest['receiving_base'],'HEAD'],check=True)
          for filename,expected in manifest['source_files_sha256'].items():
              assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
          assert len(manifest['stages'])==3 and [s['expected_cases'] for s in manifest['stages']]==[14,2,4]
          original=json.loads(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-budget.json').read_bytes())
          additional=json.loads(pathlib.Path(extra['path']).read_bytes())
          assert original['expected_actual_cases']==16 and additional['expected_actual_cases']==4
          assert [b['case_names'] for b in manifest['banks'][:2]]==[b['cases'] for b in original['banks']]
          assert manifest['banks'][2]['case_names']==additional['bank']['cases']
          assert [b['class'] for b in manifest['banks']]==[s['class'] for s in manifest['stages']]
          workflow='.github/workflows/attacking-token-defender-qualification.yml'
          source={**manifest['source_files_sha256'],workflow:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(workflow).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/attacking-token-defenders'); out.mkdir(parents=True)
          (out/'source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'candidate_head':head,'tree':tree,
              'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':source,
              'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Execute original sixteen and separate prospective four complete cases
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          set -o pipefail
          capture_failed=0
          for bank in 'AttackingTokenDefenderChoiceTest:token-defender-14' 'DalkovanEncampmentScenarioTest:dalkovan-2' 'EntryChoiceEventProvenanceTest:entry-event-provenance-4'; do
            class=${bank%%:*}
            stage=${bank#*:}
            just test-class "$class" --rerun --info --stacktrace \
              --max-workers=1 -PkotlinCompileParallelism=1 \
              -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g \
              2>&1 | tee "build/reports/attacking-token-defenders/$stage.log"
            status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            printf '%s\n' "$status" > "build/reports/attacking-token-defenders/$stage-exit-status.txt"
            # A later invocation of the same Gradle test task can replace its XML directory.
            # Preserve this exact bank immediately, before any subsequent invocation starts.
            python3 - "$stage" <<'PY'
          import json,pathlib,shutil,sys
          manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json').read_bytes())
          matches=[item for item in manifest['stages'] if item['stage']==sys.argv[1]]
          assert len(matches)==1
          item=matches[0]; out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/attacking-token-defenders')
          folder=out/'tests'/item['stage']; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
          shutil.copyfile(out/(item['stage']+'-exit-status.txt'),folder/'exit-status.txt')
          xml=pathlib.Path(item['module'])/'build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+item['class']+'.xml')
          assert xml.is_file(), 'Missing actual XML immediately after bank '+item['stage']
          shutil.copyfile(xml,folder/xml.name)
          PY
            if [ "$?" -ne 0 ]; then capture_failed=1; fi
          done
          exit "$capture_failed"
      - name: Reconcile raw cases with the unchanged shared collector
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,subprocess
          root=pathlib.Path('.'); out=root/'build/reports/attacking-token-defenders'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          path=root/'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/attacking-token-defender-receiving.json'; raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          errors=[]
          try:
              source=json.loads((out/'source-provenance.json').read_text())
              assert source['candidate_head']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['manifest_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
              for filename,expected in source['source_sha256'].items():
                  assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
              assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError) as exc:
              errors.append('Exact receiving source binding failed: '+str(exc))
          # Read only each bank's immediately retained XML and exit status; never refill from a later task.
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shared_collector','lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py')
          collector=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(collector)

          actual=sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows)

          if sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows[:2])!=16: errors.append('Original16 token bank incomplete')
          if len(rows)<3 or rows[2].get('actual_cases',0)!=4: errors.append('Separate prospective4 provenance bank incomplete')
          for bank,row in zip(manifest['banks'],rows):
              if set(row.get('case_names',[]))!=set(bank['case_names']): errors.append('Frozen case identities differ: '+bank['class'])
          (out/'actual-case-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'INCOMPLETE_OR_FAILED' if errors else 'PASS_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_ARTIFACT_REVIEW',
              'stages':rows,'actual_cases':actual,'scope_partition':manifest['scope_partition'],'errors':errors,'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors}))
          raise SystemExit(1 if errors else 0)

          manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())

          (out / 'card-sources.json').write_bytes(manifest_path.read_bytes())

          import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess

          workflow='.github/workflows/shared-current-combat-qualification.yml'
          source={**manifest['source_files_sha256'],workflow:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(workflow).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/shared-current-combat'); out.mkdir(parents=True)
          (out/'source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'candidate_head':head,'tree':tree,
              'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':source,
              'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Execute the original thirty-two deterministic cases
        shell: bash
        run: |

          set -o pipefail
          just test-class CombatAssignmentCurrentRulesTest \
            --tests '*CombatResolutionBoardTest' --tests '*CombatDamageAssignmentTest' \
            --tests '*BandingTrampleDrainScenarioTest' --rerun --info --stacktrace \
            --max-workers=1 -PkotlinCompileParallelism=1 \
            -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g \
            2>&1 | tee build/reports/shared-current-combat/qualification.log
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          printf '%s\n' "$status" > build/reports/shared-current-combat/command-exit-status.txt
          exit 0
      - name: Reconcile raw cases with the unchanged shared collector
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess
          root=pathlib.Path('.'); out=root/'build/reports/shared-current-combat'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          path=root/'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/current-combat-receiving.json'; raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          errors=[]
          try:
              source=json.loads((out/'source-provenance.json').read_text())
              assert source['candidate_head']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['manifest_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
              for filename,expected in source['source_sha256'].items():
                  assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
              assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError) as exc:
              errors.append('Exact receiving source binding failed: '+str(exc))
          for stage in manifest['stages']:
              folder=out/'tests'/stage['stage']; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
              status=out/'command-exit-status.txt'
              if status.is_file(): shutil.copyfile(status,folder/'exit-status.txt')
              xml=root/stage['module']/'build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+stage['class']+'.xml')
              if xml.is_file(): shutil.copyfile(xml,folder/xml.name)
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shared_collector','lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py')
          collector=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(collector)
          rows,case_errors=collector.collect_case_rows(out,manifest['stages']); errors.extend(case_errors)
          actual=sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows)
          if len(rows)!=4 or actual!=32: errors.append('Original four-bank32 scope incomplete')
          for bank,row in zip(manifest['banks'],rows):
              if set(row.get('case_names',[]))!=set(bank['case_names']): errors.append('Frozen case identities differ: '+bank['class'])
          (out/'actual-case-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'INCOMPLETE_OR_FAILED' if errors else 'PASS_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_ARTIFACT_REVIEW',
              'stages':rows,'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors,'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors}))
          raise SystemExit(1 if errors else 0)
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: shared-current-combat-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/reports/shared-current-combat/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
